tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example} 1. ch12:12.13For $m\geq 2$ and $n\geq 1$, every Riemannian metric on $S^m\times S^n$ has positive sectional curvature at some point. \end{example}

A space is aspherical if $\pi _k$ vanishes for every $k>1$.
